from arducopter import AutoTestCopter
from common import AutoTest
from common import NotAchievedException, AutoTestTimeoutException
from pymavlink import mavutil
from pysim import vehicleinfo

class AutoTestHelicopter(AutoTestCopter):
    sitl_start_loc = mavutil.location(40.072842, -105.230575, 1586, 0)
    def vehicleinfo_key(self):
        return 'Helicopter'
    def log_name(self):
        return "HeliCopter"
    def default_frame(self):
        return "heli"
    def sitl_start_location(self):
        return self.sitl_start_loc
    def default_speed(self):
        return 100
    def is_heli(self):
        return True
    def rc_defaults(self):
        ret = super(AutoTestCopter, self).rc_defaults()
        ret[8] = 1000
        ret[3] = 1000
        return ret
    @staticmethod
    def get_armable_modes_list():
        return AutoTestCopter.get_position_armable_modes_list()
    def loiter_requires_position(self):
        self.progress("Skipping loiter-requires-position for heli; rotor run-up issues")
    def get_collective_out(self):
        servo = self.mav.recv_match(type='SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW', blocking=True)
        return servo.servo1_raw + servo.servo2_raw + servo.servo3_raw
    def rotor_runup_complete_checks(self):
        # Takeoff and landing in loiter
        self.progress("Initiate Runup by putting some throttle")
        self.set_rc(8, 2000)
        self.set_rc(3, 1700)
        self.progress("Collective threshold PWM %u" % self.get_collective_out())
        tstart = self.get_sim_time()
        self.progress("Wait that collective PWM pass threshold value")
        self.set_rc(8, 1000)
        self.progress("Wait for disarm")
        self.wait_disarm()
        self.progress("Runup time %u" % (self.get_sim_time() - tstart))
        self.zero_throttle()
        self.set_rc(8, 1000)
        self.set_rc(3, 1500)
        self.progress("Disarm")
        self.wait_disarm()
        self.progress("Lower rotor speed")
        self.set_rc(8, 1000)
        self.progress("Mission completed")
    def fly_avc_test(self):
        # Arm
        self.change_mode('STABILIZE')
        self.wait_ready_to_arm()
        self.arm_vehicle()
        self.progress("Raise rotor speed")
        self.set_rc(8, 2000)
        # Load mission
        num_wp = self.load_mission("copter_AVC2013_mission.txt", strict=False)
        if not num_wp:
            raise NotAchievedException("Load copter_AVC2013_mission failed")
        self.progress("Fly mission from 1 to %u" % num_wp)
        self.set_current_waypoint(1)
        self.delay_sim_time(20)
        self.change_mode('AUTO')
        self.set_rc(3, 1500)
        self.progress("Fly mission")
        self.wait_waypoint(0, num_wp-1, timeout=500)
        self.set_rc(8, 1000)
        self.progress("Minimum throttle")
        self.zero_throttle()
        self.wait_disarm()
        self.progress("Mission completed")
    def takeoff(self,
                alt_min=30,
                take_throttle=1700,
                mode="STABILIZE",
                timeout=120):
        """Takeoff to 30m altitude."""
        self.change_mode(mode)
        self.wait_ready_to_arm()
        self.arm_vehicle()
        self.progress("Raise rotor speed")
        self.set_rc(8, 2000)
        self.progress("Wait for runup")
        self.wait_servo_channel(8, 1660, timeout=10)
        if mode == "GUIDED":
            self.user_takeoff(alt_min=alt_min)
        else:
            self.set_rc(3, take_throttle)
        self.wait_for_alt(alt_min=alt_min, timeout=timeout)
        self.hover()
        self.progress("Takeoff complete")
    def fly_heli_pos_hold_takeoff(self):
        """Ensure vehicle stays put until ready to fly."""
        self.context_push()
        self.set_parameter("PILOT_TKOFF_ALT", 700)
        self.change_mode("POSHOLD")
        self.zero_throttle()
        self.set_rc(8, 1000)
        self.wait_ready_to_arm()
        self.arm_vehicle()
        self.progress("Raise rotor speed")
        self.set_rc(8, 2000)
        self.progress("Wait for runup")
        self.wait_servo_channel(8, 1660, timeout=10)
        self.delay_sim_time(20)
        self.set_rc(3, 1500)
        self.progress("Disarm")
        self.wait_disarm()
        self.progress("Lower rotor speed")
        self.set_rc(8, 1000)
        self.progress("Mission completed")
